convention: Main narrative structure, section order, abstract form, display types and quantitative ranges. Frequency-derived narrative elements remain convention checks.
amaniStandard: Reporting, transparency and reproducibility obligations, including headed Limitations, declarations, registries, checklist and supplement deliverables. These remain blocking for Amani papers even when published exemplars omit them.

positiveControl.warnAndWaivableRates: reported as context, not a rejection threshold for typical items
